description:
Stand straight with your feet together and hands by your sides.

Jump and spread your legs apart.

At the same time, raise your hands above your head.

Jump again and bring your legs back together.

Lower your hands back to your sides.

Kneel down on the floor first.

Place both hands on the floor in front of you.

Keep your hands under your shoulders.

Stretch your legs straight back.

Lift your knees off the floor.

Keep your body straight like a straight line (from head to heels).

Kneel down on the floor.

Place your forearms on the floor (elbows under your shoulders).

Stretch your legs straight back.

Lift your knees off the ground.

Keep your body straight from head to heels.

Hold this position and breathe normally.

Lie down on your back.

Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.

Place your hands behind your head or cross them on your chest.

Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.

Lower your shoulders back down slowly.

Stand straight with your feet shoulder-width apart.

Keep your back straight and chest up.

Bend your knees and push your hips back (like sitting on a chair).

Lower your body until your thighs are almost parallel to the floor.

Push through your heels and stand back up.

Lie down on your stomach.

Place your hands under your shoulders.

Keep your legs straight and feet flat on the floor.

Slowly push your upper body up using your hands.

Keep your hips and legs on the floor.

Look slightly upward and hold for a few seconds.

Slowly lower your body back down.
